**Overall Odds of winning a prize with EXTRA! are 1 in 3.8

***Sales stop on draw nights at 6:59 PM Arizona time.

****Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
FANTASY 5
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Ask for a Quick Pick and let the computer select the numbers for you, or choose your own 5 numbers (1 – 41).

Add EXTRA!** for $1 or $2 more for a chance to win up to $250 or $500 instantly!

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Fantasy 5 tickets cost $1 per game and can be purchased*** at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match your numbers to the numbers selected**** in the drawing to win cash prizes.
